messages:
lina: Heads-up: ran a quick comparison of the new reranker-v2 (PTQ int8) with our "primed-short" template vs bare queries. weird split by corpus: WebFAQ improves NDCG@10 but Support set MRR drops.

arjun: metrics? small sample or full holdout?

lina: quick snapshot (holdout: 2026-03-05 stratified intents, n=4.5k):

```
corpus  | arm     | ndcg@10 | mrr
------- | ------- | ------- | -----
webfaq  | base    | 0.701   | 0.451
webfaq  | primed  | 0.714   | 0.447
support | base    | 0.662   | 0.401
support | primed  | 0.649   | 0.386
```

noah: curious if this is tokenization boundary stuff. priming adds a short natural prefix, could change subword splits for short queries and introduce tie flips.
arjun: can you diff tokenized outputs for failing queries?
lina: did that for ~20 fails: primed adds tokens in the first word for many short queries, top2 score gaps shrink < 1e-3, ordering flips. also saw HTML-heavy docs amplify the drop.

noah: aha — so hypothesis: priming -> different tokenization -> PTQ quantization noise -> tighter score margins -> tie flips -> MRR dips. webfaq likely benefits from extra context so NDCG rises.
arjun: good. action plan?
lina: propose: 1) run paired ab but with --strip-html on candidates 2) re-run PTQ calibrate with 2 different seeds (seed=7, seed=99) to assess quant instability 3) add deterministic tie-breaker by doc_id in ranking code 4) collect per-query delta histograms and slice by query length / html-noise.

arjun: also try priming variant that uses a punctuation-safe prefix (e.g., "Query:\n") to avoid merging tokens. Might reduce boundary shifts.
lina: nice. i'll queue jobs and attach the eval commands. current command used:

```
./bench/eval_rerank --model models/ranker-v2-int8.ptq
  --holdout s3://bench/holdouts/2026-03-05.json
  --priming templates/primed-short.json
  --metrics ndcg@10,mrr --seed 13 --samples 4500 --out /tmp/run_primed.json
```

noah: I want tokenization diffs logged per-query. add `--emit-token-diff` so we can quickly grep.
lina: will do. scheduling now. tagging slices: "short-queries", "support-html-heavy".

ci-bot: job 6276543225 started: eval_rerank (primed vs base, strip-html=false, samples=4500).

arjun: after those runs, let's compute an "effect matrix" (per-slice ndcg_delta, mrr_delta, tie_rate_delta) so we can decide whether to enable priming by default or gate it behind corpus-specific routing.
lina: agreed. i'll upload artifacts to s3 and post summaries. will also run the punctuation-safe prefix variant as a follow-up. :white_check_mark:
